plainTranslation: A's mind meets B's mind. The opposition pulls them into push-and-pull.

summaryDeep: You think and talk in ways that keep catching on each other. Similar enough to engage constantly, different enough to misread. Slow down and check what they actually meant.
tension: The challenge comes when the conversation becomes more focused on proving a point than understanding each other. One person explains, the other responds, and before long both of you are reacting instead of listening. Each person is working so hard to be understood that genuine understanding starts to disappear from the exchange.
advice: The practice is simple, but it takes intention. Slow down enough to hear what they are actually saying instead of rushing toward your rebuttal. Get curious about the perspective behind their words. You do not have to agree with their conclusions to learn from them. Sometimes the very thing that frustrates you is the thing expanding your view. Respect the possibility that their mind is holding a piece of the truth that is harder for you to see from your side of the conversation.
summaryShort: You think and talk in ways that keep catching on each other.
